fields.title: Gamma/Q transfers and branch convention
fields.finding: Gamma's smooth full curve and Q=.82 are projected model transfers. The 021b baseline sets gamma=1 in the Vc>=2 crimp branch. Thus Q-plus-strength's 16.282 m crossing does not establish flotation at literal gamma=.20. The requested flat-.20 benchmark is separately negative at every radius.
fields.next_evidence: Establish shell knockdown and wrinkling behavior for the chosen geometry, seams and measured imperfection distribution.
fields.check_disposition: Retained physical/model limitation. Arithmetic reproduction does not establish an installed-hull allowable.
